Name: (AT CP DGA) Pumpkin Junimo Plushies
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
I turned the same Junimos from my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10300](CP) Pumpkin Junimos Replace Spirit's Eve Maze Spiders[/url] into decorations. They can be bought from Robin's.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10300][/url][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10300] [/url][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] *ONLY for DGA SDV version 1.5
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] *ONLY for AT SDV version 1.6﻿
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[/list]
[b][u]DGA Notes:[/u][/b][list]
[*]Decorations turn into chairs when placed on tables (DGA bug)
[*]Not compatible with: CJB Item Spawner and stacking mods due to DGA having a different item system.
To spawn items, enter [font=Courier New]dga_store[/font] in the SMAPI console to open the DGA spawn menu.[/list][b][i]
